item.title: Meta Does It Right With Nuclear Power
item.description: Meta announced a private partnership with three nuclear firms to expand electricity production for their own needs and the regional grid.

item.title: Congress Erupts Over Fed Chair Investigation
item.description: Congress backs the Federal Reserve as the DOJ investigates Chairman Powell for perjury.

item.title: ‘NATO Should Be Leading the Way’ for US to Aquire Greenland, Trump Argues
item.description: The U.S. “needs Greenland for the purpose of National Security,” Trump says, adding the nation “is vital for the Golden Dome."

item.title: 'Why Is It Taking So Long?' Senate Health Chair Urges Immediate FDA Action on Abortion Pill
item.description: The Food and Drug Administration should "immediately" restore in-person dispensing requirements on the abortion pill, says Sen. Bill Cassidy.

item.title: Victor Davis Hanson’s Co-Host Shares Update on Lung Cancer Recovery
item.description: Daily Signal senior contributor Victor Davis Hanson is recovering from major cancer surgery that removed part of his lung.

item.title: Jerome Powell Gets His First Subpoena
item.description: The Fed is single-handedly responsible for billions (if not trillions) in lost revenue. Maybe the Fed and Powell should both be prosecuted.

item.title: 'Ground Zero of a Culture War': Title IX Showdown Hits SCOTUS
item.description: Supreme Court hears Title IX cases as lawmakers and supporters rally over women’s sports and the cases' nationwide implications.

item.title: State Department Pauses Visa Processing for 75 Countries, Including Somalia
item.description: The State Department is pausing visa processing for 75 countries where immigrants are deemed likely to become a "public charge."

item.title: What's Next as House Mulls Contempt Vote Against Both Clintons in Epstein Probe?
item.description: "Hillary Clinton joined her husband in defying a bipartisan lawful Congressional subpoena," Rep. James Comer says.

item.title: Ohio Gov. Mike DeWine Responds to Fraud Concerns
item.description: As daycare fraud concerns affect states throughout the nation, Gov. Mike DeWine addressed a problem he acknowledges is happening.
